# PrimeCrest Construction Management

> Self-hosted construction management platform for the Pakistan market, developed by Spyder Solutions. BOQ and estimating in PKR, quantity takeoff from PDF / DWG / BIM, rate analysis, scheduling, procurement, site diaries, interim payment certificates, and federal / provincial sales tax on services (FBR, PRA, SRB, KPRA, BRA). PEC contractor categories. Urdu and English UI. AGPL-3.0, derived from OpenConstructionERP by Artem Boiko / DataDrivenConstruction.

## Repo structure

- `backend/` - Python 3.12+ / FastAPI API server, modular, Pydantic v2, PostgreSQL
- `frontend/` - React 18 / TypeScript SPA, AG Grid, Three.js, PDF.js
- `services/` - standalone services (CAD converter, CV pipeline, AI service)
- `packages/` - shared schemas, SDK, UI kit
- `data/` - seed data, cost databases, regional catalogues
- `desktop/` - Tauri desktop app
- `deploy/` - Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform configs

## Key technical details

- **Currency and tax**: PKR default; sales tax on services per province (PRA, SRB, KPRA, BRA) and federal (FBR / ICT); withholding on contractor payments
- **CAD formats**: DWG, RVT, IFC, PDF - converted via the cad2data pipeline to canonical JSON / Parquet
- **Validation**: rule-based checks on every estimate (missing quantities, zero rates, unit consistency)
- **Languages**: Urdu (RTL) and English, plus additional interface languages
- **Module system**: manifest-based modules, drop-in install
- **AI**: optional, bring-your-own LLM provider; every suggestion requires human confirmation
